svg.title: Apex: an autonomous Formula Student Driverless stack in C++20
svg.desc: An autonomous racing stack and the simulator it races in. On a cone track it has never seen, the car maps the cones on lap 1 with LiDAR, camera and EKF-SLAM, then races laps 2 to 10 on a minimum-curvature raceline with model predictive control. 33 of 33 ten-lap runs on unseen tracks finished with no cone hit; median map error 1.4 cm after lap 1; the MPC's p99 compute time is 341 microseconds on one core. Drawing: a generated circuit with its cones as mapped on lap 1, the centerline and the raceline, and a car driving the raceline at its planned speed.
